note: Hipcamp on a 48-acre farm where the prairie meets the foothills, 6 miles from Saco, with sunsets over the Milk River valley, ancient teepee rings and adjoining BLM land to walk. Self-contained campers only. Nelson Reservoir and Sleeping Buffalo Hot Springs nearby. A 2026 review relays the host's warning not to use Apple Maps for directions. --Claude
summary: Host's Hipcamp listing (live, 35 reviews, 97%, latest Oct 2026, one from a 23-ft class B): confirmed $32/night, 50 dispersed RV/tent sites, no electric/water hookups, no toilets/showers/potable water, reservable on Hipcamp; added 18-month booking window, check-in rules, no flush/vault toilets. Max rig length not recorded (site says 'Vehicles under 100 ft' but the site picker also shows '30 ft'). Not stated: sewer, season. Note trimmed of restated values and the unsupported 'north of Saco'.
flags: Presence: no website of its own; the only channel is the Hipcamp listing (live, bookable, 35 reviews to Oct 2026). Google Maps lists 'Heritage Hills Farm RV and Camp Sites' as a Campground with phone +1 406-220-2656 (matches the entry) but only 3 reviews (4.7), short of the 25-review presence bar, and no website.
